answer: Carrion Americas reported Q3 2023 revenue of $19.5 million, up 7.2% YoY, driven by Timber frame construction contracts and Sable's final project. Gross margin was 56.3% (vs 52.1% prior), with operating expenses rising 12% to $2.1M including $450K in R&D. Net loss narrowed to $1.8M (-9.2% YoY) reflecting improved scalability yet remaining constrained near nadir amid macroeconomic volatility. Strategic initiatives focus on reducing timber supply chain dependencies while ruggedizing Sable’s hardware for enterprise adoption across sulfidicOAD sectors.
